description:
Run standalone DeepSeek OCR on a PDF, Office document, or image and return page-by-page text.

MCP uploads up to 10 MiB; use HTTP for files up to 32 MiB. Supports text_recognition and
rich_layout_recognition. Charged per recognized page; provider errors and timeouts are free.
Pass the same idempotency_key on retries after a timeout (auto-generated when omitted).
name: ocr_document
